context.title: The Son Works as the Father
context.summary: At the pool of Bethesda Jesus heals a man ill for thirty-eight years, on the Sabbath. Accused of breaking the Sabbath and making himself equal with God, Jesus explains his oneness with the Father and lists witnesses to who he is.
context.background: Excavations near St. Anne's Church in Jerusalem uncovered a large double pool matching John's description of five porches. The end of v. 3 and v. 4, about an angel stirring the water, are missing from the earliest manuscripts.

customs.term: Carrying a bed on the Sabbath
customs.note: Carrying a burden from one place to another was counted as Sabbath work (compare Jeremiah 17:21). The man's mat was a light pallet.

watchFor: 'My Father worketh hitherto, and I work' (v. 17).
Witnesses to Jesus: John, his works, the Father, the Scriptures (vv. 33–39).
'Had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me' (v. 46).

people.name: Jesus
people.also: Immanuel, Emmanuel, Messiah, Shiloh, Christ, Jesus Christ, Messias
people.summary: Anointed, the Greek translation of the Hebrew word rendered “Messiah”, the official title of our Lord, occurring five hundred and fourteen times in the New Testament.

people.name: John
people.summary: The “forerunner of our Lord.” We have but fragmentary and imperfect accounts of him in the Gospels. He was of priestly descent.

people.name: Moses
people.summary: Drawn (or Egypt. mesu, “son;” hence Rameses, royal son). On the invitation of Pharaoh (Gen. 45:17-25), Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt.

places.name: Jerusalem
places.summary: Called also Salem, Ariel, Jebus, the “city of God,” the “holy city;” by the modern Arabs el-Khuds, meaning “the holy;” once “the city of Judah” (2 Chr. 25:28).

places.name: Bethesda
places.summary: House of mercy, a reservoir (Gr. kolumbethra, “a swimming bath”) with five porches, close to the sheep-gate or market (Neh. 3:1; John 5:2). Eusebius the historian (A.D. 330) calls it “the sheep-pool.”

places.name: sheep gate
places.summary: One of the gates of Jerusalem mentioned by Nehemiah (3:1, 32; 12:39).

events.title: Bethesda pool healing
events.summary: Passage: John 5:1–47. People: Jesus. Place: Bethesda.
